reviews.text:
Dropped off my cat for boarding as her usual boarding facility was fully booked.

When I arrived, I was met with the worst kennel stench imaginable. I asked for a tour of the cat boarding area only to find that it was not far separated from the dog area, which I can imagine would be very traumatizing for a cat to hear all that barking. It also seemed like the area was a repurposed storage closet that they tossed some kennels in and called it adequate enough for cats. Not to mention it was not very clean.

Ended up picking up my cat the same day. Did not feel comfortable leaving her in Alta Vista care considering the condition of the facility. Luckily, the boarding place I typically use had some last minute availability I was able to switch over to.

I have no ill will towards the staff-they were cooperative and kind enough to not charge me anything for the few hours I had my cat staying there. Just putting this out there as a caution to others wanting to board their cat(s).
Love them they take good care of my baby boy

I've been using the grooming services for a while now, never had any issue. I received a call from a member "you might want to make you way down here, your pet is in a bad situation." I arrived staff member brought out my pet DEAD. groomer said "We left to turn off the washer, it happened to fast." My pet was left unattended by groomer. This experience has made me seriously question the ethics, integrity, and standards of your entire operation. Pets are family, they deserve far better than what mine experience here.
I’ve been boarding my two fur babies there for several years now. I also get the little one trimmed there. Love this place. The staff are absolutely wonderful.

I’ve been using the grooming services for awhile and never had any issues until this most recent appointment. My sweet dog had hot spots (sores) all over him. He required veterinary treatment which included shaving around his neck, along with steroids and a foaming medication to be applied once a day. He is in pain and it breaks my heart. I will definitely not be returning.
We’ve boarded our pup here many times and they always take great care of her. The staff are patient and do a wonderftjob working with her when she’s anxious. Highly recommend.

There are so good with my cat Ellie. The only groomers I use for her. They are professional, yet friendly. You never feel like you are imposing on them when you ask for something specific regarding care.
I always board my dogs here and never have a problem. Plenty of options to choose from. That even board for the day if need. Price not bad and vets next door and you can get all your animals shots.
Staff is amazing!

I’ve been a customer of Alta Vista Veterinary and expected a much higher level of care — especially after paying for VIP boarding services that included baths for both of my dogs over the 4th of July weekend. What I got instead was completely unacceptable and honestly, heartbreaking.

When I picked them up, they were covered in urine, and their beds were soaked. My Shipoo, whose coat I work hard to maintain, was severely matted with knots all over his body. I had to pay to get him completely shaved after a year of taking care of his coat. Despite the VIP package including a bath, I was told he had been bathed earlier in the stay — not the day of pickup — which meant I brought him home filthy and neglected.

Even worse, both of my dogs were visibly traumatized and had bug bite marks all over their bodies. When I called to share my concerns, I was told they had 50–60 dogs that weekend and “didn’t have time to brush them.” That is not an acceptable excuse when you are charging for premium-level care.

I asked to speak with a manager and was promised a call back — no one ever followed up. That silence speaks volumes about the level of accountability at this facility.

You didn’t just lose me as a boarding client — you’ve lost me entirely. I will never bring my pets here again, not even for veterinary care. This experience has made me seriously question the ethics, integrity, and standards of your entire operation. Pets are family — and they deserve far better than what mine experienced here.
Thank you for taking care of my Bluey. Thank you for grooming him also.
Honey absolutely enjoyed a day of pampering at Alta Vista Grooming. Thank you again ladies
I had to kennel my fur baby due to a funeral, they kept my baby busy, safe & not alone! Thank you Alta Vista!
Used doggy daycare for the first time. Our puppy is always happy to see this facility so he must be getting appropriate care!
I've been taking my husky here for over a year.  He's always excited to come. The staff always makes the check in/,out process easy.
Outstanding
They change the price very often without warning.

I don't recommend it. I took my Golden Retriever to be bathed and asked them to brush his hair, not cut it. When I picked him up, they had removed his hair and he smelled bad, as if he hadn't been bathed.
They did an AMAZING job with my 21week old pup and as long as I am in AZ they will be the only ones to touch him
Great, quick dog grooming service. Our dog looks wonderful and it’s the shortest we’ve ever been able to get his nails! Reasonably priced. Friendly staff. Will be back!
Great place and people for dog boarding/daycare and grooming!
